comparison.objective: Arrange five cartons on two pads so no stack exceeds three times its base dimension.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object placement, stacking-order reasoning, orientation choice, and hand-off; no tooling or impact.
comparison.success_condition: Each correctly seated/centered carton scores; any stack exceeding its base-derived height limit zeros the overall score. Numeric seating/centering and stability thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests geometric stability planning and stacking, unrelated to fracture mechanics, insert retention, or fragment recovery.
